charts.title: XO-3 b: orbits around XO-3
charts.description: The orbits of XO-3's planets in this map from above, to scale, with XO-3 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Sodickson & Grunblatt 2025 (2025ApJ...993...78S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SODICKSON__AMP__GRUNBLATT_2025): P 3.19152255771 d

charts.title: XO-3 b: its transit
charts.description: XO-3 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (59, 73, 86) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 8400842, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 12-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 12-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
